# sfcompute_events (Data Source)

Reads events from SF Compute (`GET /preview/v2/events`). All pages are fetched unless `limit`, `starting_after` or `ending_before` is set.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `action` (String) Only return events with exactly this action.
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of events to return per page.
- `since` (Number) Unix timestamp. Only return events that occurred at or after this time.
- `starting_after` (String) Return events after this cursor, exclusive. A cursor only works with the same `action`, `target`, and `target_type` it was created with.
- `target` (String) Only return events about this target id.
- `target_type` (String) Only return events whose targets are this kind of resource. Redundant if `action` is specified.
- `until` (Number) Unix timestamp. Only return events that occurred at or before this time.

### Read-Only

- `cursor` (String) The last event's cursor. Pass it as `starting_after` to fetch the next page. Omitted when `data` is empty.
- `data` (Attributes List) The page of events, in the order they were recorded. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `has_more` (Boolean) Whether more events are available after this page.

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) The event type. Current values are `instance.created`, `instance.running`, `instance.failed`, `instance.connection_lost`, `instance.termination_imminent`, `instance.terminated`, `order.created`, `order.filled`, `order.cancelled`, `image.published`, `image.revoked`, `image.reinstated`, `image.deprecated`, `trust_level.updated`, `instance_sku_override.updated`, and `instance_sku_override.deleted`. New values may be added later.
- `actor` (Attributes) Who performed the action. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--actor))
- `cursor` (String) Resume the stream from just after this event by passing this value as `starting_after`.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the event.
- `occurred_at` (Number) Unix timestamp (seconds) of when the event occurred.
- `targets` (Attributes List) The resources the event is about, as `{type, id}` pairs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--targets))

<a id="nestedatt--data--actor"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.actor`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The id of the token that performed the action.
- `type` (String) The kind of actor.


<a id="nestedatt--data--targets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.targets`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The resource's id.
- `type` (String) The kind of resource.
